newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank says no news conference after meeting.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank says no news conference after meeting.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday that it did not plan to hold a news conference after its regular fortnightly council meeting today.

There were few expectations that the Bundesbank would cut key German interest rates, particularly after comments on Wednesday by Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing, who said there was no reason to expect further cuts in rates.
"Key rates are at a historic low here and nothing more is to be expected or necessary," Issing said in an interview on German television.
